def normalize_name(name: str) -> str:
    import re
    
    # 将非英文字符替换为临时占位符
    temp_name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z]', '@', name)
    
    # 去掉括号及括号内的内容
    temp_name = re.sub(r'\(.*?\)', '', temp_name)
    
    # 将临时占位符恢复为原来的非英文字符
    result = re.sub(r'@', lambda m: name[name.find(m.group(0))], temp_name)
    
    return result.lower().replace(' ', '')
